requestedIntent: Keep ACEF Quick Fix fast by enforcing one independent review, deterministic closeout, hard budgets, and no duplicated Full BMAD review stack.
limitations: New Quick Fix runs use quickFixContract single-review-v1; existing records without it remain compatibility state.
The successor contract is enforced and regression-tested but has not yet completed a live controlled canary, so the capability is not yet proven at this version.

The 20-minute alert is an operating rule; the 30-minute stop, actor/evidence/commit/file/line budgets, framework-failure stop, reviewer binding, and stale completed-run isolation are validator-enforced.
The validator checks declared quick-fix evidence paths and touched-surface evidence, plus heuristic path-name inference for obvious hidden risk and surface expansion.

The validator enforces changed test files against the quick-fix envelope and blocks obvious test-gutting patterns; symbol graph envelope derivation is still recorded by the conductor rather than fully inferred by the validator.
Expanding or planning-heavy fixes promote to ACEF Full; high-risk fixes add Guarded assurance independently.
